clue.text: Make excessive bid to be in charge of Grub Street hack?

parts.note: someone in charge of a team is over it, the boss above it
a hack writer of Grub Street, London's old home of poor scribblers, is a sub-scribe, a scribe of the lowest grade

explanation.surface: A hack writer bids too much in an attempt to take control of Grub Street.
explanation.walkthrough: Grub Street was the London street of struggling hack writers; read the second half as SUB-SCRIBE, an inferior scribe. 'to be' simply links.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversubscribe is to apply or bid for more than is on offer, as with a share issue.

clue.text: Perhaps litre vessels which could erupt

parts.note: a litre is an example of a volume, abbreviated VOL
canoes are small boats, i.e. vessels

explanation.surface: Containers holding a litre each that might boil over.
explanation.definitionFit: Volcanoes are mountains that may erupt with lava; the definition describes them by that behaviour.

clue.text: Organ's actually found to contain nitrogen

indicators.note: the word for actually is made to hold the nitrogen symbol within it

parts.note: for real means actually, in fact
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A body part is discovered really to hold nitrogen.
explanation.definitionFit: Renal is the adjective for the kidney, so it means 'belonging to that organ'; the possessive matches the adjective.

clue.text: Reformed RC Union which didn't really exist

indicators.note: reformed means shaped anew, so the letters of RC and Union are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Roman Catholic trade union restructured that was never real.
explanation.definitionFit: The unicorn is a mythical horned horse, a creature of legend that never lived.

clue.text: Hurried to get ear pierced

indicators.note: the word for hurried gets, i.e. takes in, the ear in its middle

parts.note: sped means hurried, went fast

explanation.surface: Someone rushes off to have an ear pierced.
explanation.definitionFit: Speared means run through with a point, the same as pierced.

clue.text: Giving a rest about description of model?

parts.note: re means about, concerning
an artist's model holds poses, so is jokingly pose-ful, full of poses

explanation.surface: A sitter for an artist is described as giving a rest.
explanation.walkthrough: POSEFUL is a made-up word: a model who poses a lot is 'full of poses'.
explanation.definitionFit: Reposeful means restful, offering calm and relaxation.

clue.text: Possibly a sob's heard in a low voice

indicators.note: possibly says the letters of a sob's could form another arrangement

parts.note: the possessive s is kept as a letter here

explanation.surface: A sob might be heard coming in a low, deep voice.
explanation.walkthrough: Here the S of sob's counts as fodder, so A SOBS is rearranged; 'heard in a' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A basso is a bass singer, whose voice is the lowest male range.

clue.text: Black power?

parts.note: read not as the political slogan but as power from a black stone, i.e. a jet-black gem, joined to a word for driving force

explanation.walkthrough: JET is a black stone and PROPULSION is power, but the clue reads as the civil-rights slogan.
explanation.definitionFit: Jet propulsion is thrust produced by expelling a stream of gas, a form of motive power.

clue.text: Direction causing ado-water's shut off

indicators.note: off means out of order or wrong, so the letters of ado-water's shut are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive s is kept as a letter here

explanation.surface: A direction that causes a fuss when the water is turned off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'causing' is a link; the S of water's counts as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Southeastward names a compass bearing, a direction of travel between south and east.

clue.text: Plant producing gelatin on Tyneside

indicators.note: producing suggests making something new from the letters of gelatin

parts.note: Tyneside is in the North East of England, abbreviated NE

explanation.surface: A shrub that makes gelatin in Newcastle.
explanation.walkthrough: Tyneside is the area around Newcastle in northeast England.
explanation.definitionFit: Eglantine is the sweet briar, a wild rose shrub.

clue.text: Sauce from supermarket not right?

indicators.note: not says the abbreviation for right is left out of the shop's name

parts.note: Presto was a British supermarket chain

explanation.surface: Is a sauce from the supermarket the wrong one?
explanation.walkthrough: Presto was a UK supermarket chain of the 1980s and 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: Pesto is an Italian sauce of basil, pine nuts, garlic and parmesan.

clue.text: Quiet noble's gem

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
an earl is a nobleman; the 's is 'is' joining the pieces

explanation.surface: A quiet aristocrat owns a jewel.
explanation.definitionFit: A pearl is a lustrous gem formed inside an oyster.

clue.text: Male left old car with radical thing perfumers use

indicators.note: left means departed, so the abbreviation for male goes out of the car's name

parts.note: Morris was a British car make, now gone
radical means of the root, so it gives that word

explanation.surface: A man abandons a vintage car together with an extreme article used in scent-making.
explanation.walkthrough: Morris was a classic British car maker (the Morris Minor).
explanation.definitionFit: Orris root is the dried rhizome of an iris, used to fix and scent perfumes.

clue.text: Old American recruited by Nixon, possibly, a graduate

indicators.note: taken into the ranks of, so the letter for American goes inside the reworked name
possibly says the letters of Nixon may be rearranged

explanation.surface: A veteran American hired by President Nixon, perhaps a college man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' turns NIXON into XONIN; A goes inside to give XONIAN after O.
explanation.definitionFit: An Oxonian is a graduate or member of Oxford University.

clue.text: One very heretical in New Testament, not for changing

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

indicators.note: the very heretical pieces sit inside the abbreviation for New Testament

parts.note: Arian refers to the heresy of Arius, who denied Christ's full divinity

explanation.surface: A deeply heretical figure in the New Testament refuses to change.
explanation.definitionFit: Invariant means constant, never altering, so it is not open to change.

clue.text: recently

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as only 'recently' (7): the OCR has lost the start of the clue, and a search of the text found nothing to restore it.

clue.text: Almost crash by church, which is learned about in Grammar School?

definitions.text: which is learned about in Grammar School?

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter of the crash word is dropped

parts.note: a crash is an accident
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A near collision beside a church, the sort of thing pupils study at grammar school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grammar School' suggests a kind of school, but it means the study of grammar.
explanation.definitionFit: Accidence is the part of grammar dealing with inflections of words, so it is studied by grammarians.

clue.text: But hampered by a French daughter you could lose such a program

definitions.text: you could lose such a program

indicators.note: the but word is hemmed in by the French article and the daughter letter on each side

parts.note: un is French for a
save means but, except

explanation.surface: A computer user, held up by a French girl, may lose work.
explanation.definitionFit: A program that has not been stored to disk can be lost when a computer crashes.

clue.text: Soft leather works supported by family

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second, which holds it up

parts.note: does means performs, works at
kin means family, relatives

explanation.surface: Fine leather goods are backed by a family business.
explanation.definitionFit: Doeskin is the soft leather made from a female deer's hide, or an imitation of it.

clue.text: Spirals traced out by male parasites on sailor's head

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
lice are parasitic insects

indicators.note: head means the first letter of the word sailor's

explanation.surface: Lice crawl in spirals on a sailor's head.
explanation.definitionFit: Helices is the plural of helix, a spiral or corkscrew curve.

clue.text: Handle work around line coming to peak

indicators.note: around says the handle and work pieces go round the line letter

parts.note: a hilt is the handle of a sword
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Work a handle around a rope to reach a summit.
explanation.definitionFit: A hilltop is the summit of a hill, its peak.

clue.text: Source of energy perhaps also right for use with small room

indicators.note: put to use in a new form, so the letters of also with right are rearranged

parts.note: a cell is a small room, as in a prison or monastery

explanation.surface: An energy source can also be used in a tiny room.
explanation.definitionFit: A solar cell turns sunlight into electricity, one example of an energy source.

clue.text: Carrier of burdens moving up a street

indicators.note: in a down clue moving up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: a mall is a street, as in The Mall in London

explanation.surface: A pack animal climbs a road.
explanation.definitionFit: The llama is a South American animal used to carry loads.

clue.text: Provide funds to put a stop to cry of pain

parts.note: to end something is to stop it
ow is what one cries when hurt

explanation.surface: To fund something so as to stop it hurting.
explanation.definitionFit: To endow is to give money as a permanent fund for an institution.

clue.text: Anaesthetic making one forget hernia, when cut?

indicators.note: cut means a piece is sliced out from the words forget hernia

explanation.surface: A drug lets the patient forget a hernia during surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: The surgery picture of 'cut' disguises the slicing of letters from 'forget hernia'; 'making one' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Ether was one of the first general anaesthetics used in surgery.

clue.text: Port's large, also known as a Japanese place

parts.note: OS is outsize, the clothing abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A large port, otherwise called a Japanese town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port's' is an extra description, since the city is a major port.
explanation.definitionFit: Osaka is a large city and port in Japan.

clue.text: Where cook may appear before Queen in general?

indicators.note: the place comes ahead of the queen letters

parts.note: a cook is found working in the kitchen
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Where a cook might show up ahead of the Queen, in general terms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in general' looks like 'generally' but 'general' is the definition: Lord Kitchener, the British army commander.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord Kitchener was a British field marshal, the general of the WWI recruiting poster.

clue.text: Essential component of role with bundle?

parts.note: a part is an actor's role
and means with, together
a parcel is a wrapped bundle

explanation.surface: The essential element of an acting role comes with a package.
explanation.definitionFit: Part and parcel is an idiom for an integral, essential element of something.
